title: Closure Fingerprint v1
description: Canonical identity-excluding closure fingerprint per DSS-2.0-PEO-payload-requirements.md §3.2 and PEO-GOV-02. Mirrors Elephant's elephant.closure.v1 design: fingerprint covers the gate surface only — identity, custody, and enrichment lineage are excluded so that portability does not alter identity. Two PEOs with identical gate surfaces share a fingerprint; this is the dedup / replay-equivalence anchor.

canonical_form.description: JSON Canonicalization Scheme over the sorted field set; separator-stable

gate_surface.description: Canonical string of the 10 patch outcomes + quaternary levels, e.g. 'p001:pass|p002:pass|...|eq6:level_3|eq7:level_3|eq8:level_3'

impact_hash.description: Optional: hash of the action-impact surface for class-A PEOs

excluded_fields.description: Identity/custody/enrichment excluded so portability preserves identity (PEO-GOV-02, PEO-MESH-04)
